title: Retained legacy assets from the pinned history rehearsal
scope_note: These are the exact Core/Extensions/Studio source pins recorded by the disposable current-Core rehearsal, not a claim about current upstream main. Every asset remains inert at its .source path until its disposition is implemented and verified.

canonical_build_gap.observed: The root PR workflow invokes ./build.cmd Compile Test; root NUKE enumerates TestProjects from Elsa.sln. The rehearsal build proof uses generated Consolidated.sln, so it does not prove that imported projects or tests are included by canonical CI.
canonical_build_gap.next_implementation: In the existing #8214/#8215 integration work, define the canonical full-build solution (or explicit solution set), add the intended imported projects/tests to root CI and NUKE, and retain product-scoped developer/release entrypoints where needed. Keep package publication outside this CI path.
acceptance: A clean history-preserving rehearsal at refreshed, reviewed source pins validates original ancestry and receipt before applying only reviewed integration changes.
Root PR CI and NUKE build/test the documented imported project set from the canonical solution using each project declared target framework; report the exact enumerated solution/project/test counts.
Project-reference source builds and package-reference consumer/pack restores are both tested; product-specific central package versions and NuGet package-source mappings are explicit.
CI is non-publishing. Historical Extensions and Studio publisher workflows remain inert until one publisher per package ID, cutover order, upgrade, and rollback are separately accepted.
Each ledger row changes from pending to implemented or retired only with an evidence link/commit and an exact-head check; remove inert .source copies only after its disposition is complete.
